pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high-frequency textural edge serration. Patch size is largest on the lower neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more compressed polygons toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned negative space forming a topological graph of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the flank but narrows significantly at the neck-shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth profile along the dorsal neck line, characterized by individual hair tuft projections visible against the light background.
